theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (b : Fin m → Euclid P), LinearIndependent ℝ b → 0 < Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j => inner ℝ (b i) (b j)) ∧ ∀ ξ : MultiVector P m, (∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) m, ξ α * Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j => inner ℝ (b i) (b j))) = α b) → IsUnitOrientationOf ξ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range b))
